FROM (

      SUM(
        (CASE
          WHEN hits.eCommerceAction.action_type = '2'
               AND (NOT COALESCE(hp.isImpression, FALSE))
          THEN ARRAY_LENGTH(hits.product)
          ELSE 0
        END)
      ) AS product_detail_pageviews,
      -- count add-to-cart product occurrences: ecommerce action type = '3'
      SUM(
        (CASE
          WHEN hits.eCommerceAction.action_type = '3'
          THEN ARRAY_LENGTH(hits.product)
          ELSE 0
        END)
      ) AS add_to_cart_product_count,
      -- count purchase product occurrences: ecommerce action type = '6'

        END)

    UNNEST(hits) AS hits

      fullVisitorId,

    p.*,
    LAG(geom) OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY pt_rank) AS prev_geom,
    LAG(latitude) OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY pt_rank) AS prev_latitude,
    LAG(longitude) OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY pt_rank) AS prev_longitude
  FROM points p

legs_dist AS (
  SELECT
    sid,
    name,
    season,
    iso_time,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    usa_wind,
    pt_rank,
    prev_geom,
    CASE
      WHEN prev_geom IS NULL THEN 0.0
      ELSE ST_DISTANCE(prev_geom, geom)  -- meters

-- cumulative distance per storm (meters)
cumulative AS (
  SELECT
    sid,
    name,
    season,
    iso_time,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    usa_wind,
    pt_rank,
    leg_meters,
    SUM(leg_meters) OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY pt_rank ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_meters
  FROM legs_dist
),

  SELECT

    name,
